metadata.description: Ibrahim's personal plugin marketplace for Cursor and Agent Plugins

plugins.name: printful-automation
plugins.description: Automate a Printful print-on-demand store: browse the catalog, generate mockups, create products, manage design files, place and track orders, and produce store reports through the Printful REST API. Packaged to the Agent Plugins v1.0.0 standard.

plugins.name: design-school
plugins.description: Watch a design video, extract rules with adversarial verification, capture supporting frames, and publish the lesson to a Notion library that coding agents consult during design work.
